title: A client paid part.
accent: The work still has to move.
caption: Splitt · Project payments with a plan
narration: A client pays part of an invoice. Contractors are waiting, while the project still needs a reserve. Splitt turns the shortfall into a reviewed payment plan, with a reason behind every amount.

title: Start with the facts.
caption: Synthetic example · 2,000 invoice · 1,200 received · 300 reserve
narration: This synthetic Northstar example starts with a two thousand USDC invoice. Twelve hundred arrived, and three hundred stays protected. Splitt records the obligations, accepted work and payment terms before it proposes where the remaining nine hundred can go.

title: The agent drafts the split.
caption: Evidence-aware draft · deterministic checks · owner review
narration: When a receipt arrives, the hosted worker drafts a plan automatically. Here, Amara receives seven hundred, and Tobi receives a permitted partial payment of two hundred. A separate validator checks the reserve, eligibility, caps, evidence and current project state.

title: The owner keeps control.
caption: Current facts → exact signature → Circle execution → chain reconciliation
narration: The owner reviews the exact batch and signs it in their own wallet. The signature binds the vault, plan, ordered payments and expiry. Circle's operator executes the batch, while durable reconciliation checks the chain before any recovery attempt.

title: New cash creates a fresh plan.
caption: The 800-USDC remainder unlocks only the unpaid 300
narration: When the remainder arrives, Splitt replans from what is still owed. Amara is already complete. Tobi receives only his outstanding three hundred. The earlier authorization cannot be counted twice, and the project keeps the rest.

title: Each vault keeps its own cash.
caption: Synthetic final state · project balances never cross
narration: Northstar finishes with its obligations paid and eight hundred USDC remaining. Fieldwork's separate one thousand USDC balance stays untouched. Each user owns their vault, and Splitt never borrows one project's cash to satisfy another project's commitments.

title: The public path is proven.
caption: Controlled Arc Testnet evidence · 18 October 2026
narration: The public website and API are live. Three controlled vaults completed four Circle-executed batches totalling two point four test USDC. The latest run used a Haiku draft and paid zero point three USDC. These are controlled tests, not customer traction.

title: Try the live testnet workspace.
caption: Arc Testnet · USDC · Circle developer-controlled wallets
narration: Splitt is live on Arc Testnet, with a verified contract, a public API and one hundred eighty five passing tests. Connect a wallet to run the flow, or preview it without one. Controlled evidence is public; verified business pilots remain zero.
